# Variable `BUILD_CFLAGS`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the flags to pass to the C compiler when building for the build host. When building a native recipe, CFLAGS is set to the value of this variable by default.

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/variables.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-BUILD_CFLAGS)
